title: Integer Linear Programming Decoder for Abelian and Non-Abelian Topological Codes
summary: Topological orders (TOs) are widely used as quantum error-correcting codes, with anyon excitations serving as error syndromes. For certain Abelian TOs, decoding can be performed by independently matching particle-antiparticle pairs of each species. However, matching-based decoders cannot handle more general fusion rules in either Abelian or non-Abelian TOs, nor account for noise that correlates different anyon species.
